name: Goat Cheese Stuffed Aubergine with Spiced Walnuts
description: Baby aubergines stuffed with toasted walnuts, bloomed cumin and coriander, and warm French chevre — a Pakistani-French fusion starter or vegetarian main that is halal and alcohol-free.
recipeYield: 4 servings as a starter, 2 as a main
keywords: goat cheese stuffed aubergine, stuffed baingan recipe, chevre aubergine, walnut stuffed eggplant, halal, vegetarian
recipeIngredient: 100 g (3½ oz) walnut halves, lightly toasted
1 small red onion (about 80 g / 3 oz), finely minced
3 tbsp fresh coriander leaves, roughly chopped
150 g (5½ oz) soft fresh chevre, at room temperature

recipeInstructions.name: Preheat oven
recipeInstructions.text: Preheat the oven to 200°C / 400°F (fan 180°C). Line a baking tray with parchment.

recipeInstructions.name: Prepare aubergines
recipeInstructions.text: Make two perpendicular slits in each baby aubergine from the stem end downward, leaving the base intact so the aubergine opens like a flower when pressed. Rub olive oil into the slits and over the skin. Season with salt.

recipeInstructions.name: First roast
recipeInstructions.text: Place the aubergines on the baking tray and roast for 18–20 minutes until the skins are wrinkled and the flesh is beginning to soften but not fully collapsed.

recipeInstructions.name: Make the spiced walnut filling
recipeInstructions.text: Heat 1 tbsp olive oil in a small frying pan over medium heat. Cook the red onion for 5 minutes until soft. Add garlic and green chilli and cook 90 seconds. Add cumin, coriander, smoked paprika, and black pepper; stir 30 seconds. Remove from heat and mix with crushed walnuts, lemon juice, fresh coriander, and salt.

recipeInstructions.name: Prepare the chevre
recipeInstructions.text: Work the room-temperature chevre with olive oil, dried thyme, and black pepper until smooth and spreadable.

recipeInstructions.name: Fill the aubergines
recipeInstructions.text: Remove aubergines from the oven. Gently press each open at the slits. Press a generous teaspoon of chevre into the base of each cavity, then pack 1–2 tablespoons of walnut filling on top.

recipeInstructions.name: Second roast
recipeInstructions.text: Return the filled aubergines to the oven for 10–12 minutes until the chevre is visibly melted and the walnut filling is darkened at the edges.

recipeInstructions.name: Finish and serve
recipeInstructions.text: Transfer to a serving plate. Scatter fresh coriander and walnut pieces over the top. Drizzle with pomegranate molasses if using (about ½ tsp per aubergine). Serve immediately.
